limitations: Only candidates[].votes.total was used; NYT models, estimates, expected votes, and EEVP were ignored.
Exact county FIPS are matched against the local GeoJSON. Township aggregation is used only when no county-level reporting units exist, grouping by source fips_state+fips_county.

call_authority.authority: AP is identified only for offices whose outcome.called_by explicitly contains ap.

preferred_verified_source.provider: Reported election returns via The New York Times
preferred_verified_source.message: 95 counties with published returns. Source times apply to the published race feed; individual local update times are not supplied. Unofficial counts; no forecast or expected-vote estimates are included.
